$comment: The page the First today card opens per rule (today-first-per-school-role T1). Every page is one the full menu offers every role the rule is for, so Today links nothing a role could not already reach (REQ-STD-003); tests/unit-js/structureProfile.test.mjs checks that per role. A rule without a page here gets no card: the exam rules belong to a role the simple Today is not for. The placement rules are the BPV view's (bpv-coach-today-and-placement-board T5); hours waiting opens the placements, which carry the hours waiting per placement, because the full menu offers a teacher no BPV hours list.
